svg.desc: GitHub Actions validates three independent paths • Release promotion reuses the tested image manifest. Detailed source mapping is provided in README.md.
svg.text: From a source change to software and a website
GitHub Actions validates three independent paths • Release promotion reuses the tested image manifest
Separate workflows; required checks gate merge
PRs validate candidates; each workflow runs its own checks. Raw data and private replay bundles are excluded from publication.
PR image builds stop after testing and scanning. The release path requires the commit image to exist before the tag is pushed.
In parallel: release.yml verifies the tag, version, citation and publication facts. The owner checks both workflow outcomes.
The Pages workflow builds from repository assets. It does not deploy the GHCR container, and it never deploys from a pull request.
Separate image, release-verification and website jobs; arrows show artifact flow, not a single workflow dependency chain.
